notes.title: CORPSE FACTORY is out now!
notes.content:
The game is now available on Steam, and we’re working on making it available on other digital storefronts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1414250/CORPSE_FACTORY/

Working on CORPSE FACTORY has been a truly remarkable experience. The development team is thankful for your ongoing support!

We couldn’t have brought this project to life without you. From the bottom of our hearts, we want to offer our sincerest thanks!

notes.title: CORPSE FACTORY is coming soon - listen to Emi Evans performing the OP!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Fpkrhk6MeWo;full][/previewyoutube]

Emi Evans has lent her extraordinary vocal and lyrical talents to CORPSE FACTORY! Emi is well known for her work on a multitude of game soundtracks, including Nier: Automata, Dark Souls and Granblue Fantasy. In addition to game music, she has even performed on Star Wars: Visions!

Composed by Alec Shea, and with lyrics written and performed by Emi Evans, ‘Strange Flower’ will serve as the opening theme for CORPSE FACTORY. It’s a dark, hauntingly beautiful track that truly emcompasses the motifs of the game.

You can wishlist CORPSE FACTORY on Steam today!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1414250/CORPSE_FACTORY/]CORPSE FACTORY on Steam[/url]


‘Strange Flower’ credits:

Composed by Alec Shea
Lyrics/Vocals - Emi Evans
Piano - Rob Kovacs
Cello - Mason Lieberman
Mix Engineer - Masahiro Aoki
Score Engraving Assistance - Thomas Misson
Emi Evans is represented by Scarlet Moon Productions

June 1st, 22:00 UTC.

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.content: Today's update brings [i][b]Steam Trading Cards[/b][/i] to the game! There are lots of cards to collect, as well as badges, backgrounds and emotes. It's time to study hard and collect all of those cards!

notes.title: New Game Spotlight: How To Date A Magical Girl!
notes.content:
Although it's a change of pace from learning Japanese, we wanted to highlight a very interesting new game! [i][b]How To Date A Magical Girl![/b][/i] is a visual novel that looks calm and peaceful on the surface, but there are untold horrors lurking in the depths...

You attend a prestigious magical academy and make friends with five very attractive and talented magical girls. Do your best to win their affection by giving them gifts, spending time together and working hard to get through the school year.  However—things soon take a turn for the worst when one of your fellow students is brutally murdered. Your world shatters in an instant and from that moment on, nothing is quite the same...

[i][b]How To Date A Magical Girl![/b][/i] is available now on Steam:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/881560]https://store.steampowered.com/app/881560[/url]

We're taking the time to highlight this game because the talented composer behind [i][b]Learn Japanese To Survive! Kanji Combat[/b][/i] also produced the soundtrack for [i][b]How To Date A Magical Girl![/b][/i] Alec Shea has outdone himself with a soundtrack that perfectly captures the magic behind this new game. If you're a fan of visual novels, do yourself a favor and check out this genre-bending game that pulls no punches!

notes.title: Learn Japanese To Survive! Kanji Combat has launched on Steam!
notes.content:
It's finally here! Learn Japanese kanji in style. Study hard to overcome fearsome enemies. The more you learn, the more powerful you'll get!

You can pick up this fantastic game for just $8.99USD. There's also plenty of additional content available, including a study guide, flash cards and a fantastic original soundtrack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/759440

notes.title: Release Date: 1st August!
notes.content:
Hello classmates!

We want to share some wonderful news today.

Learn Japanese To Survive! Kanji Combat will release on Steam on 1st August!

Thanks to our successful beta testing program, we've been putting the finishing touches on the game. Everything is just about ready to go, and the release date is booked in with Steam!

In regards to the release time: The game should be available to download and play by early evening on 1st August for North America. The time will vary a little for the rest of the world, such as Australia, which will gain access early on 2nd August.

Not long to go now - we hope you're looking forward to it!
